title: Cosmetology
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units

program.section_heading: Cosmetology Concepts - Certificate of Achievement - CE960
outcomes: Deduce valid conclusions, compare, and contrast viable techniques and apply principles in preparation of the California State Board of Barbering and Cosmetology practical and written exam.
Identify and analyze concepts leading to synthesis of theory for the state board written exam. Produce a business plan and portfolio.
Demonstrate entry-level industry skills in a clinic laboratory setting.
Demonstrate workplace behaviors (“soft skills”) necessary for success in the cosmetology industry.

notes: The page heading covers both the A.S. degree and the Certificate of Achievement (AS960/AS960C/CE960); a single requirements list and a single Program Learning Outcomes list are printed for the program as a whole, and the certificate (CE960) shares them, so both were recorded here.
Catalog prints codes with a hyphen (COS-60A1, etc.); these match the closed-list codes (COS 60A1, etc.), so none is marked as a catalog addition.

Every course title is labeled '( Historical )' in the catalog text, which may indicate the courses are inactive or being retired; reviewer should confirm this listing applies to the 2026-2027 catalog year.
